conclusion: The MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the high-level CMC/analytics requirements cited (orthogonal characterization, separation from non-vesicular particles, transparent reporting, and appropriate controls) as necessary before attributing in vivo effects to intact EVs or advancing formulations. However, program-specific factual claims about SGL-001 (absence of MCB/WCB, lack of validated assays/LLOQ/precision, absence of GMP-like batch comparability, and unresolved rodent-to-large-animal translatability for this program) are not supported by the supplied evidence, which contains only the consensus guidance and no SGL-001 manufacturing, assay validation, or biodistribution data.
unsupported_assertions: Assertion that current SGL-001 materials demonstrably lack characterized source-cell MCB/WCB and scalable, reproducible production (no program manufacturing records provided in allowed evidence).

Assertion that validated, fit-for-purpose intact-EV assays for SGL-001 (LLOQ, specificity, precision) are absent or that assay validation has been performed/not performed for this program (no validation reports present in allowed evidence).
Assertion that comparability data across three GMP-like SGL-001 batches demonstrating reproducible release/stability/potency are absent (no batch reports in allowed evidence).

Assertion that SGL-001 rodent intranasal biodistribution data are insufficient to predict large-animal/human CNS exposure for this program cannot be directly substantiated from the MISEV guideline alone (guidance recommends such bridging and controls but provides no program-specific translational data).
